# Dictionary.com

> > Dictionary.com provides comprehensive language resources including word definitions, a thesaurus, and interactive word games and puzzle tools.

Dictionary.com is a leading online dictionary and language reference platform offering lexicography services, word game tools like Anagram Solver and Word Search Maker, and puzzle games developed in partnership with Arkadium. The site serves both language learners and word game enthusiasts across web and mobile platforms (iPhone and Android).

## Key Topics

- Dictionary.com
- Lexicography
- Anagram Solver
- Word Search Maker
- Scrabble Word Finder
- Crossword Solver
- Word games
- Puzzle tools
- Mobile apps (iPhone and Android)
- Arkadium games
- Letter unscrambler
- Printable puzzles
- Help center and FAQ
- Thesaurus

## Word Game Tools & Puzzle Helpers

- [Anagram Solver Online - Free Online Game | Dictionary.com](https://play.dictionary.com/games/dictionary-anagram-solver): Anagram solver tool for unscrambling letters in word games like Scrabble
- [Word Search Maker - Free Online Game | Dictionary.com](https://play.dictionary.com/games/dictionary-word-search-maker): Create and print custom word search puzzles online

## Help & Support

- [Dictionary.com Help Center](https://help.dictionary.com/): Help center for Dictionary.com and Thesaurus.com user support

## Optional

- [10x10 Game - Free Online Game | Dictionary.com](https://play.dictionary.com/games/ten-x-ten): Tetris-like 10x10 grid puzzle game with block placement mechanics
